subject: [PATCH v5 22/22] Documentation: iomap: update docs to reflect iomap_iter_next model

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch updates the iomap documentation to reflect a change in how filesystems interact with the iomap API. Specifically, it removes the need for separate ->iomap_begin() and ->iomap_end() callbacks, instead using a single iomap_iter_next() callback that finishes the previous mapping (if any) and produces the next one. The patch updates three documentation files to match this change.
